leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a parent component that imports and renders child components
Configure props to pass data from parent components to child components
Implement event listeners to handle child component emissions in parent components
Apply slots to compose flexible content structures between components
Integrate dynamic components using Vue's built-in <component> element
Manipulate component composition patterns to build reusable UI structures
Initialize and bind component instances with proper data flow patterns
